text:
maria: Quick check — proposing a compact \"Entitlement surface\" row in the Role editor that collapses per-route toggles into a single micro-summary. Goal: reduce vertical noise for enterprise tenants with 100+ routes. Sketch: https://figma.redwood/ent-surface-compact :eyes:
aj: love the idea. main question: how do we keep auditability? admins need to know exactly which routes are affected without drilling 100x.
kevin: agree with aj. also worried about discoverability — collapsing could hide critical overrides (e.g., model-routing overrides that change cost).
jules: design thought — compact row should show three micro-pill states: Allowed / Conditional / Restricted. clicking expands an inline panel with affected routes and a 1-line reason. Hover shows a small telemetry preview (top 3 routes by traffic).
ramya: engineering note — backend will need an efficient way to compute the \"affected routes\" set for a role without querying every route. I propose a new endpoint: GET /v1/internal/effective_entitlements?role_id=<id>&preview=1 which returns a diff-ish summary. Example response (sketch):
```json
{
  \"role_id\": \"r_123\",
  \"summary\": [
    {
      \"scope\": \"route:invoke\",
      \"count_matching_routes\": 127,
      \"sample_routes\": [\"/api/generate\", \"/api/embeddings\"],
      \"overrides\": [\"model:route:override\"]
    }
  ]
}
```
aj: that endpoint looks good. telemetry team: can we surface a small sparkline for each sample route? even tiny CPU/token rate or fallback count would help.
audit-bot: New doc created: \"entitlement-surface-compact\" in Google Drive by maria — https://drive.redwood/ent-surface-compact (automated note).
kevin: quota interaction question — if role-level compact view hides per-route quota overrides, we need an indicator (e.g., ⚠️) if any route in the sample set has a quota override or higher priority billing flag. Otherwise ops might miss cost surprises.
jules: UI idea — pill shows badge count: e.g., \"3 overrides\" and a tooltip listing types (quota, model-override, region-lock). Expand shows checkboxes to preview changes but edits still require going to the full route editor.
ramya: perf caveat — computing sample_routes and counts for every role on the fly could be expensive. Suggest we cache effective_entitlements per role and invalidate on route-policy changes. signature: (role_id, route_policy_version). Cache TTL maybe 5m.
maria: sounds reasonable. rollout plan: start behind a feature flag for 10% of tenants, surface telemetry only for admins, and add fallback to full expanded view if the preview fails.
aj: and add telemetry events: ent.compact.view, ent.compact.expand, ent.compact.override.click — we need these to judge adoption and mis-clicks.
kevin: one more: ensure audit logs show the action path when someone edits from the compact preview vs full editor. auditing must capture pre/post snapshots.
jules: can design add a tiny \"view diff\" CTA in the expanded panel that opens the audit diff modal?
maria: yes. action items:
- ramya: prototype effective_entitlements endpoint + caching (ETA 1w)
- aj: add telemetry events and schema (ETA 3d)
- jules: updated Figma with hover + expanded panel (ETA 4d)
- kevin: define audit log fields we need for edits from compact UI (ETA 3d)
- maria: feature flag + rollout plan doc (ETA 2d)

ramya: adding note — backend will return a \"heavy\" flag if the computation would scan >500 routes; UI should then show \"Preview unavailable — open full editor\" to avoid slow loads.
maria: perfect. thanks all :thumbsup:
aj: ack
kevin: ack
jules: ack
ramya: will post PR link when ready
audit-bot: Reminder scheduled: review ent.compact telemetry next Wednesday 15:00 PT.
